have h_μ_Ω : μ Ω = 1 := MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure.univ_measure μ
have h_A_complement : MeasurableSet Aᶜ := by infer_instance
have h_additivity : μ A + μ Aᶜ = μ (A ∪ Aᶜ) := 
  MeasureTheory.measure_add_of_disjoint μ hA h_A_complement
have h_union_eq_Ω : A ∪ Aᶜ = Ω := by simp
have h_sum_eq_1 : μ A + μ Aᶜ = 1 := 
  calc μ A + μ Aᶜ = μ (A ∪ Aᶜ) := h_additivity
    ... = μ Ω := by rw h_union_eq_Ω
    ... = 1 := h_μ_Ω
rw [h_sum_eq_1]
ring
